open.close.settings.description: You can turn the HUDs on and off.
hide.settings.description: Hide can be set to appear in the GUI and Debug screen.
hide.hidegui.description: Hide GUI (F1) allows you to set whether it is visible or not.
hide.debuggui.description: This controls whether or not the debug GUI is visible, i.e., whether it is visible with the (F3) key.
appearance.settings.infohud.direction.de: Allows you to set the layout of Info HUD to Horizontal and Vertical.
appearance.settings.infohud.textshadow.d: Turns the text shadow of Info HUD on and off.
appearance.settings.infohud.background.d: Info changes the background of HUD to None, Light and Full.
appearance.settings.infohud.xposition.de: Adjusts the position of the Info HUD on the X-axis.
appearance.settings.infohud.yposition.de: Adjusts the position of the Info HUD on the Y-axis.
appearance.settings.infohud.decimalplace:
Allows you to adjust the decimal places of the coordinates. 
"6" represents the default decimal places.
Turns the text shadow of Armor HUD on and off.
Changes the background of Armor HUD to None, Light and Full.
appearance.settings.armorhud.durabilityb: Opens and closes the durability bars of the armor.
Turns empty slots on and off in Armor HUD.
appearance.settings.armorhud.handitems.d: Opens and closes hand items on Armor HUD.
appearance.settings.armorhud.hudscale.de: Sets the size of Armor HUD from 0.50 - 1.50.
appearance.settings.armorhud.location.de: Sets the on-screen location of Armor HUD.
appearance.settings.armorhud.textstyle.d: Allows you to change the styles of Armor HUD's health text to None, Remaining, Percentage, Damage, and Remaining/Max.
display.settings.coordinates.description: Show or hide player coordinates on the HUD.
display.settings.yaw.direction: Show or hide player yaw on the HUD.
display.settings.pitch.direction: Show or hide player pitch on the HUD.
display.settings.direction.description: Show or hide player direction on the HUD.
display.settings.fps.direction: Show or hide player FPS on the HUD.
display.settings.converter.direction: Show or hide player coordinate converter on the HUD.
